methods.source: Installed SDK back.webp/mask.webp/layout match all 18 current upstream Git blob IDs. Actual model.glb positions and UV accessors read directly; no stale front.png used.
methods.contours: Checked all six existing body and screen outlines against a fresh in-memory half-alpha extraction. Exactly zero boundary distance for every stored outline. Previous representative 6/6Pro/7a measurements reused as corroboration, no replacement circle fits or trace generation.
methods.rail: Manual metal/glass gasket picks from raw SDK back.webp and frame.png, corroborated by transverse seam stopping at the gasket. Bright highlight inside that boundary is glass. Straight-side and top widths measured separately; sidewidth is a representative projected width, not a CAD cross-section.
methods.seams: Half-open pixel intervals along visible outer metal. Edge picks informed by smoothed intensity transitions, then inspected in enlarged crops. Side axis is y from top; top/bottom axis is x from left. Widths vary with rail projection. Do not infer absent bands or a universal six-band template.
methods.coordinates: Front view X right, Y up, origin body center. Side center_axis_mm is Y; top/bottom center_axis_mm is X. Seam mapping uses published dimension per axis; OLED retains one isotropic height-derived scale and original native aspect.
methods.glb: glTF local coordinates X right, Y depth/front, Z down; mesh_summary includes node translation in millimetres. Body projected convex hull versus published-W/H-normalized official trace, boundary sampling <=0.10 mm. Earlier <=0.02 mm run agreed to displayed precision. Curved topmost-face X extents alone are not a physical roll-radius measurement.
methods.uncertainty: Manual material boundary +/-2 px (~0.10-0.12 mm); high/medium seam endpoint +/-2 px each, low-contrast +/-4 px. Width uncertainty can be twice endpoint uncertainty. SDK artwork is stylized; shader roughness, rail roll depth and optical layer depths are estimates.

parent_integration.generator_patch: In make_pixel_profiles.py, after SDK-derived screen fitting, preserve the four explicit body_mm.front_rail_mm and edge_roll_mm[1] values listed per device. Read measured screen_cutouts_mm from trace for all six instead of the generated 1.5 mm circle. For 7Pro use trace screen_rect_mm for fit and XY center. Do not regenerate a concentric body outline from screen radius plus bezel; keep independent trace body and OLED contours.
parent_integration.flat_rails: Current geometry.py already consumes front_rail_mm and asymmetric edge_roll_mm. Four flat profiles therefore require no new schema for these changes. Keep back-roll unchanged. Reducing front-roll exposes a front metal landing within measured projected metal width. These are provisional cross-section fits pending parent render QA.
parent_integration.curved_rails: 6Pro/7Pro require distinct lateral and top/bottom metal/glass boundaries; their measured lateral metal is narrower than their top strip. Current max(front_rail_mm, front_roll*.95) and one all-edge slab roll cannot express that. Keep front_curve=1.0 and screen.edge_curve_mm=1.0. Preserve the already exported 1 mm screen Z sag and native UV mapping. Fit the exposed side rail to the curved glass surface height, and a separately shallow top/bottom roll; do not make a high flat ledge adjacent to the lower curved screen edge. Side/top width targets and provisional top roll are recorded per device, not blindly applied to the old scalar API.
parent_integration.antenna_helper: Use each device.seams as explicit edge/center_axis_mm/width_mm measurements. Clip polymer patches to the actual exposed enclosure surface, including its rounded front lip, without covering black glass/OLED. Follow actual surface through depth, avoiding buttons/ports. Front artwork does not measure hidden depth extent; inspect side/back references when setting it. No seam data or new material role added to profiles until parent helper schema is finalized.
parent_integration.antenna_material: Separate nonmetal polymer from rail. Suggested metal=0, rough=0.60-0.70 are rendering estimates, not Google material numbers. Sample/correlate each finish; do not make all bands white or reuse graphite unchanged on every finish. Keep all existing rail, camera, rear and logo finish values.
parent_integration.selfie_optics: Use each measured screen-local cutout center and radius as outer envelope. Replace the current 0.025 mm thick black disk with a layered dark barrel/pupil and curved glass element contained within that envelope. Inner optical proportions/depth are not measurable from alpha mask; initial lens radius 0.40-0.55*cutout radius and recess 0.08-0.18 mm are estimates, requiring parent rendered QA. Use a separate optical glass material; do not lower shared black roughness globally because it also serves camera cavities and front borders. Keep the OLED/hit-test cutout identical to the measured outer hole, and do not expand it for glints.
parent_integration.acceptance: Parent rebuilds serially, then runs verify_pixels.py with body contour <=0.10 mm, exact native UV/aspect, measured holes, retained 1 mm Pro screen sag, and before/after front plus oblique renders checking metal/gasket/glass boundaries, seam continuity and recessed optics. Shared helper/export verification not run here.
